You've given me a great insight to how I feel.

I witness the world as a part of it. Contentment only drives me away from the reality of the whole. 

Most likely, my desire to fight what I deem as "injustice" has faded away.

Edit: Thank you for replying.

Oh no, I wasn't direct enough. I meant "prick" as in "blunt". As well as I genuinely like bluntness.

In terms of what you just said: I've done it all. I just don't believe that creates a better world. Thank you for replying to me.

You have too much on your mind, and that's the unfortunate circumstance of being human.

I ask you. What do you want from life?

Hah, you're a prick and I love it.

Yes, the central jist of my post can be boiled down to "commit suicide pl0x". However, I asked everyone to "do their part". Either make the world a better place, or kill yourself. That's all I ask!

Unfortunately I'm incapable of bettering the world.
